cases.name: a caveat need not lead its paragraph, so emphasis counts
caught_by: emphasis at a line break is not a caveat: untriaged: wanted 1, got 2

cases.name: the boundary is not normalised, so a first caveat is lost
caught_by: a bullet with no verdict is untriaged: untriaged: wanted 2, got 1
a verdict is read by the opening of its bullet: open: wanted 1, got 0; problems: wanted 0, got 1 ['a.md::It does not do the first thing.']
a reworded bullet orphans its verdict, and says so: untriaged: wanted 2, got 1
closed without naming what closed it is refused: closed: wanted 1, got 0
deliberate without naming the reasoning is refused: deliberate: wanted 1, got 0
an unknown verdict is refused and counted untriaged: untriaged: wanted 2, got 1
README and TEMPLATE are not entries: untriaged: wanted 2, got 1
a verdict survives an edit past the key's cut: open: wanted 1, got 0; problems: wanted 0, got 1 ['a.md::It does not cover the case where a sentence runs on well pas']
